name: ProfileMenu
description: Top-bar profile dropdown. Wraps the core DropdownMenu primitive with the user-avatar icon as the trigger. Items are caller-provided so the menu surface stays application-driven

props.name: items
props.description: Items rendered in the dropdown, top-to-bottom

props.name: user
props.description: Optional user label rendered at the top of the dropdown (e.g. an email)

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the trigger icon — defaults to the user-avatar icon

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger button

fields.name: label
fields.description: Item text; also used as the React key, so keep it unique within `items`

fields.name: onSelect
fields.description: Called when the item is chosen by click or keyboard

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional secondary line under the label (e.g. "Current: Europe/Podgorica")
